topics.label: Document Structure
topics.desc: The skeleton of every page — doctype, html, head, and body — that the browser parses into the DOM tree before rendering anything.

topics.label: Semantic Elements
topics.desc: Meaning-carrying tags like header, nav, main, article, section, aside, and footer that convey structure to browsers, search engines, and assistive tech.

topics.label: Links & Navigation
topics.desc: Hyperlinks via the anchor element with href, target, rel (noopener/nofollow), and fragment/mailto/tel schemes that wire pages and resources together.

topics.label: Forms & Input Types
topics.desc: The form element with typed inputs (email, number, date, file, range), select, textarea, label association, and built-in constraint validation attributes.

topics.label: Media & Images
topics.desc: Embedding content with img (alt, srcset, loading=lazy), picture for art direction, plus video, audio, canvas, and iframe elements.

topics.label: Metadata & SEO Basics
topics.desc: Head-level signals — title, meta description, viewport, charset, Open Graph/Twitter cards, canonical links, and JSON-LD structured data — for sharing and search ranking.

topics.label: Valid & Well-Formed HTML
topics.desc: Writing standards-conformant markup with proper nesting and required attributes, checked by the W3C validator and lint rules to avoid quirks-mode and parser surprises.

topics.label: CSS Selectors
topics.desc: Patterns that target elements — type, class, id, attribute, combinators (descendant, child, sibling), and pseudo-classes/elements like :hover and ::before.

topics.label: Cascade & Specificity
topics.desc: The algorithm that resolves conflicting rules by origin, specificity weight (id vs class vs type), source order, and !important overrides.

topics.label: Box Model
topics.desc: Every element as nested content, padding, border, and margin boxes, with box-sizing: border-box controlling whether dimensions include padding and border.

topics.label: CSS Units
topics.desc: Absolute and relative length units — px, rem, em, %, vh/vw, ch, fr, and clamp()/calc() expressions — that scale layout with context and viewport.

topics.label: Colors & Backgrounds
topics.desc: Color specification via hex, rgb(), hsl(), and oklch(), plus background images, gradients, opacity, and the alpha channel for layered visuals.

topics.label: Typography
topics.desc: Styling text with font-family stacks, @font-face/web fonts, font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and text-align for readable type.

topics.label: Display & Positioning
topics.desc: Box behavior via display (block, inline, inline-block, none) and the position scheme — static, relative, absolute, fixed, and sticky with offsets and z-index.

topics.label: Flexbox
topics.desc: One-dimensional layout distributing space along a main and cross axis with justify-content, align-items, flex-grow/shrink/basis, and wrapping.

topics.label: CSS Grid
topics.desc: Two-dimensional layout with explicit rows/columns, fr units, minmax(), template areas, and auto-placement for full page and component grids.

topics.label: Responsive Design
topics.desc: Building one layout that adapts to any screen using fluid grids, flexible images, and breakpoints rather than fixed-width or device-specific pages.

topics.label: Media Queries
topics.desc: Conditional CSS via @media that responds to viewport width, orientation, prefers-color-scheme, prefers-reduced-motion, and pointer capabilities.

topics.label: Mobile-First
topics.desc: Authoring base styles for small screens and progressively enhancing with min-width media queries, improving performance and forcing content prioritization.

topics.label: Container Queries
topics.desc: Styling a component by the size of its own container via @container and container-type, enabling truly reusable, context-aware responsive components.

topics.label: Transitions
topics.desc: Smoothly animating property changes between states with transition-property, duration, and timing-function (ease, cubic-bezier) triggered by state like :hover.

topics.label: Animations
topics.desc: Multi-step motion defined with @keyframes and the animation shorthand controlling iteration, direction, delay, and fill-mode independent of user interaction.

topics.label: Transforms
topics.desc: GPU-accelerated translate, rotate, scale, and skew in 2D/3D via the transform property, used for movement and effects without triggering layout.

topics.label: Custom Properties
topics.desc: Native CSS variables (--name) read with var(), cascading and runtime-updatable from JavaScript — the foundation of theming and design tokens.

topics.label: CSS Preprocessors
topics.desc: Authoring CSS with extra power — Sass/SCSS or Less adding variables, nesting, mixins, and partials, compiled to plain stylesheets at build time.

topics.label: CSS Methodologies
topics.desc: Naming and organization conventions for scalable CSS — BEM, OOCSS, SMACSS, and ITCSS — that fight specificity wars and clarify component boundaries.

topics.label: Utility-First CSS
topics.desc: Composing UI from small single-purpose classes (as popularized by Tailwind CSS) instead of bespoke semantic class names, trading markup verbosity for speed.

topics.label: Data Types & Coercion
topics.desc: JavaScript's primitives (string, number, boolean, null, undefined, symbol, bigint) versus objects, with implicit type coercion and strict (===) versus loose equality.

topics.label: Variables & Scope
topics.desc: Declaring bindings with let, const, and legacy var, governed by block versus function scope, the temporal dead zone, and hoisting of declarations.

topics.label: Closures
topics.desc: Functions capturing their lexical environment so they retain access to enclosing variables after that scope returns, powering callbacks, modules, and currying.

topics.label: this & Prototypes
topics.desc: Dynamic this binding (call/apply/bind, arrow lexical this) and prototypal inheritance via the prototype chain underlying class syntax and method lookup.

topics.label: ES6+ Features
topics.desc: Modern syntax that defines idiomatic JS — arrow functions, destructuring, spread/rest, template literals, array helpers (map/filter/reduce), optional chaining, and nullish coalescing.

topics.label: Promises & async/await
topics.desc: Modeling deferred results with Promises (then/catch, Promise.all/race) and async/await syntax, with rejection and error handling via try/catch and .catch for asynchronous flows.

topics.label: Event Loop
topics.desc: The single-threaded concurrency model — call stack, task and microtask queues, and non-blocking I/O — that schedules callbacks, promises, and timers like setTimeout.

topics.label: ES Modules
topics.desc: The standard module system using import/export with static analysis enabling tree-shaking, plus dynamic import() and the legacy CommonJS require contrast.

topics.label: DOM API & Manipulation
topics.desc: Reading and mutating the live document tree with querySelector, createElement, textContent, classList, and node insertion/removal, the model Web Components and frameworks build on.

topics.label: Events & Delegation
topics.desc: Handling user interaction via addEventListener, the capture/bubble phases, the event object, preventDefault, and delegation by listening on a common ancestor.

topics.label: Fetch & AJAX
topics.desc: Making HTTP requests from the browser with the promise-based fetch API (Request/Response, JSON parsing, AbortController) succeeding the older XMLHttpRequest.

topics.label: Web Storage
topics.desc: Persisting key-value data client-side with localStorage and sessionStorage, plus cookies and the indexed, async IndexedDB for larger structured data.

topics.label: Browser Web APIs
topics.desc: Platform capabilities exposed to scripts — History/Location, Geolocation, Clipboard, Intersection/Resize Observer, and the Web Animations API.

topics.label: TypeScript
topics.desc: A typed superset of JavaScript compiling to plain JS, adding static type checking that catches errors at build time and powers rich editor tooling.

topics.label: Basic Types & Annotations
topics.desc: Annotating variables, parameters, and returns with primitives, arrays, tuples, enums, any/unknown/never, and literal types to constrain values.

topics.label: Interfaces & Type Aliases
topics.desc: Describing object shapes and contracts with interface and type, supporting optional/readonly members, extension, and intersection composition.

topics.label: Unions & Narrowing
topics.desc: Modeling alternatives with union and discriminated-union types, then refining them via typeof, instanceof, in, and custom type-guard predicates.

topics.label: Generics
topics.desc: Writing reusable type-parameterized functions, classes, and types with constraints (extends) and defaults so code stays type-safe across many value types.

topics.label: Structural Typing
topics.desc: TypeScript's duck-typed compatibility where shape matters more than declared name, contrasted with nominal typing and refined by utility types like Partial and Pick.

topics.label: tsconfig & Compiler
topics.desc: Configuring the tsc compiler through tsconfig.json — target, module, strict mode, paths, and lib — and declaration files (.d.ts) for typing JS libraries.

topics.label: Accessibility Fundamentals
topics.desc: Designing so people with disabilities can use the web, guided by the POUR principles (perceivable, operable, understandable, robust) and inclusive defaults.

topics.label: WCAG Standards
topics.desc: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines success criteria and conformance levels (A, AA, AAA) that define legally referenced, testable accessibility requirements.

topics.label: Semantic Landmarks
topics.desc: Using native semantic HTML and landmark roles (banner, navigation, main, contentinfo) plus a logical heading order so assistive tech can map page regions.

topics.label: ARIA
topics.desc: Accessible Rich Internet Applications attributes — roles, states, and aria-* properties — that expose custom widgets to assistive tech when native HTML falls short.

topics.label: Keyboard Navigation
topics.desc: Ensuring everything works without a mouse via logical tab order, tabindex, visible focus indicators, focus trapping in dialogs, and skip links.

topics.label: Screen Readers
topics.desc: Testing with assistive software like NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver that narrates the accessibility tree, including alt text, labels, and live-region announcements.

topics.label: Color Contrast
topics.desc: Ensuring text and UI meet WCAG contrast ratios (4.5:1 for body text) and never relying on color alone to convey meaning, verified with contrast checkers.

topics.label: Accessibility Testing
topics.desc: Auditing accessibility with automated tools (axe, Lighthouse, WAVE), linting (eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y), and manual keyboard and screen-reader walkthroughs.
